statistical_review.simpson: Domains and both512 batches retained separately; mean Pareto is descriptive only.
statistical_review.ecological: Per-user gains/losses and coverage are reported; no universal user benefit claim.
statistical_review.berkson: Fixed eligible validation sample; not raw-population or independent test evidence.
statistical_review.collider: No hit-based user inclusion or removal; coverage bins are descriptive, not policy training.
statistical_review.base_rate: Every method evaluated on all1024 same users; top10 hit counts saved.
statistical_review.regression_to_mean: Extension requested after first512; both batches remain exploratory.
statistical_review.survivorship: All11 expert arms and all negative alpha arms retained; recovery documented.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: 240 paired descriptive intervals, unadjusted; all saved, no confirmatory p-value claim.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Synthesis follows many prior explorations; priorities are not preregistered winner selection.
statistical_review.causation: Cross-fuser pairings compare whole pipelines; they do not isolate text necessity or unique failure causes.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: Targets used only for metrics and posthoc coverage; no model fitting or new target-derived features.
